title.en: Estimated planetary Kp is 3.00 (unsettled) at 02:00 UTC on 6 October 2026.
title.zh: 2026 年 10 月 6 日 02:00 UTC，估計行星 Kp 為 3.00（不穩定）。

summary.en: Latest reliable hour-start estimated Kp is 3.00 (3Z) at 02:00 UTC on 6 October 2026. The 02:00 hour is complete (60 samples through 02:59; hour-start 3.00/3Z, hour-end 2.67/3M). Last-180 maximum is 3.33 (first at 2026-10-06T01:22:00Z; label 3P). Published-window maximum is 4.00 (first at 2026-10-05T23:12:00Z; label 4Z). Window starts 2026-10-05T22:00:00Z (358 samples). Window estimated_kp reached 4.00. The 03:00 UTC hour is incomplete (58 samples through 03:57).

evidence.limitations: Values are estimated Kp at 1-minute cadence and can be revised. The card uses the latest hour that has a full 60 samples; the following hour may still be incomplete.
evidence.method: NOAA SWPC planetary_k_index_1m.json. Main card is the hour-start estimated_kp of the latest complete hour. last-180 and published-window maxima are the first occurrence of the maximum estimated_kp in each window.
